audio.vo_script_for_post: Sunset used to end the evening. Charge it in the afternoon sun, and the Luma runs eleven hours on a single charge. Dim it for the table. Hang it in the tent. One less thing to pack, one more hour together. Fireline Luma. The night is yours.
